digest.component_or_area: LLM provider factory and session management
propositions: Provider construction logic is currently scattered inline in runner.py with provider-specific branches, requiring surgical changes for each new provider
httpx.AsyncClient lifecycle is owned by runner.py with ad-hoc teardown in a finally block, but the provider factory hook cannot return the client for cleanup
A ProviderSession object must own client lifecycle and expose a provider_factory callable matching pydantic-ai's infer_model hook signature (str -> Provider)
All httpx.AsyncClient instances created by builder functions must be registered with ProviderSession and closed in __exit__ without requiring explicit teardown in runner.py
Import sites in test files (test_llm_timeouts.py, test_transport_retry.py) currently reference _build_retrying_anthropic_model from runner and must be updated to import from anthropic_model
